science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
summary: Silas secures the primary grounding mast against the crushing magnetic shear before tossing the heavy copper baton directly into Hector's waiting hand.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Secure the primary grounding mast from the magnetic shear
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Prevent the encroaching ferrofluid wave from causing a total polarity inversion

active_location.macro_silhouette: The First Forge stood as a stoic anchor amidst the chaos, its heavy brass bulkheads groaning under the immense pressure of the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear tearing across the ferrofluid sea. Sputtering blue lightning danced across the hand-forged copper armatures, casting long, erratic shadows over the slick basalt floor. Outside, the jet-black metallic waves crested violently, threatening to devour the very foundation of the sanctuary.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: blinding azure arcs against matte jet-black waves
sensory_palette.sound: a relentless, bone-rattling hum punctuated by the shriek of stressed brass
sensory_palette.smell: acrid, burning ozone layered over the heavy metallic scent of cold iron
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: a chilling, biting cold radiating from the stone beneath the oppressive ambient heat of the electrical discharge
sensory_palette.taste_optional: a sharp, battery-acid tang lingering at the back of the throat

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be hastily recalibrated to bleed the accumulating magnetic charge deep into the bedrock.
Can draw away the sheer kinetic force of the ferrofluid impact if properly aligned.
Can safely dissipate the excess thermal load before the brass bulkheads warp.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is buckling the primary grounding mast, threatening immediate catastrophic discharge.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: If the mast fails, The First Forge will be ripped apart by the feral magnetic tide.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The exoplanet's living environment fundamentally rejects stationary Enclave engineering, requiring constant adaptation.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: The mast fractures, unleashing a localized arc-flash that severely burns the immediate area.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Silas overtightens the coupling, causing a micro-fracture that exacerbates the charge buildup.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The mast holds, but the back-surge blows out the secondary lighting arrays, plunging the forge into gloom.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Silas expertly vents the shear pressure, stabilizing the mast against the encroaching tide.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Silas discovers a way to permanently reinforce the mast using the very resonance of the shear.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Silas grunted, muscles straining as he locked the final brass retaining clamp into place. He turned, the heavy copper calibration baton slick with condensation in his grip, and lobbed it directly at Hector. 'Inefficient to stand there gawking, kid! Anchor the relay!'

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: Overwhelm structural integrity of the Enclave.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: A massive rogue wave of magnetized liquid is cresting directly toward the primary mast.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The wave will crush the outer retaining wall and flood the forge floor with lethal charge.
